delete_account_translations_subject: Confirm deletion of your Louez account
delete_account_translations_body: You asked to delete your account, your stores and their data. Open the confirmation page to review this action one last time.
delete_account_translations_warning: Nothing will be deleted until you confirm on that page. The link expires in 24 hours.
delete_account_translations_ignore: If you did not make this request, ignore this email and your account will remain unchanged.
magic_link_translations_subject: Sign in to your Louez account
magic_link_translations_body: Click the button below to sign in to your Louez account. This link is valid for 24 hours.
magic_link_translations_expiry: If you didn't request this sign-in, you can safely ignore this email.
magic_link_translations_alternative: Or copy and paste this link in your browser:
base_layout_simple_translations_sentBy: This email was sent by Louez.
base_layout_simple_translations_ignoreIf: If you didn't initiate this action, you can ignore it.
otp_translations_body: Here is your code to sign in to Louez. It is valid for 5 minutes.
otp_translations_expiry: If you didn't request this code, you can ignore this email.
index_subjectTranslations: Sign in to your Louez account
otp_reset_translations_body: Here is your code to choose a new Louez password. It is valid for 5 minutes.
otp_reset_translations_expiry: If you didn't request this code, ignore this email: your password stays unchanged.
password_changed_translations_events_add: A password was just added to your Louez account
A password was just added to your Louez account. You can now sign in with your email and this password, as well as with a code sent by email. Your other devices have been signed out.
password_changed_translations_events_cha: The password of your Louez account was just changed
The password of your Louez account was just changed. Your other devices have been signed out.
password_changed_translations_events_res: The password of your Louez account was just reset
The password of your Louez account was just reset using a code sent by email. All your devices have been signed out.
password_changed_translations_events_rem: The password of your Louez account was just removed
The password of your Louez account was just removed. You can still sign in with a code sent by email.
password_changed_translations_ownAction: If this was you, there is nothing to do.
password_changed_translations_notYou: Wasn’t you? Secure your account: the password will be removed and every device will be signed out.
password_changed_translations_signInNote: To confirm, you will be asked to sign in with a code sent by email.
